rule: Select one primary packet. Actual proof dependencies and status require original evidence; upstream lists are advisory. Review nominees recuse if contributors.

assignments.target_statement: Reprove the full entropy and influence identities for balanced disjoint substitution. Track means and the precise conditions needed when a child is later physically restricted.

deliverables.description: BALANCED_SUBSTITUTION_BASELINE.tex: exact H and I identities
COMPOSITION_INTERFACE.json: balance, block independence, and child-mean requirements

acceptance_criteria: For disjoint balanced children prove/source-pin H(g(h))=H(g)+Σ_i I_i(g)H(h_i) and I(g(h))=Σ_i I_i(g)I(h_i).
Track all child means after a physical restriction and identify where the balanced formula ceases to apply.
Complete this baseline once; do not repeatedly claim the known chain rule as progress on overlapping or biased composition.
assignments.renewal_milestone: One reusable identity/interface packet is reviewed and retired; new coherent remainder work belongs to A057.

assignments.target_statement: Use the exact coherent-composition remainder from the Brain. Seek a summable bound that retains its alpha^2 log(1/alpha^2) term rather than replacing it by O(alpha^2).

deliverables.description: COHERENT_REMAINDER_PAYMENT.tex: exact remainder and summed compensation

acceptance_criteria: Import the complete source remainder, including qα² log(1/α²) and both E_raw(a±αb) terms, with the source's nats converted consistently.
Do not replace the remainder by O(α²): the recovered logarithmic counterexample must pass as a mandatory control.
Prove a nonreusing sum across the actual physical hierarchy or a complete scoped theorem; equality of child spectra cannot be assumed after coherent substitution.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A genuinely summable coherent remainder on an unbounded composition family, or a precise scalable failure of the proposed amortization.

assignments.target_statement: Identify a nontrivial class of shared-input compositions with a provable entropy ledger. Use collision or posterior information explicitly; disjoint-block chain rules cannot simply be reused.

deliverables.description: OVERLAPPING_COMPOSITION_CLASS.tex: explicit non-selector or repeated-control class
OVERLAP_ENTROPY_LEDGER.md: collision, posterior, and influence accounting

acceptance_criteria: Choose a class distinct from A019's fresh-selector quantitative-correlation problem—for example an overlapping non-selector outer composition or controlled reuse of selector coordinates—and define it exactly.
Do not apply disjoint-block chain rules to shared physical inputs; give an actual coefficient or posterior decomposition.
State and prove the structural hypothesis paying the full collision debt, with the bent-splice selector-only increment failure included when relevant.

advisory_upstream.interface: boundary of the already studied selector classes

assignments.renewal_milestone: A new explicitly defined shared-input class with a complete entropy ledger and controlled influence cost.

assignments.target_statement: Prove a factorization or stopping theorem that limits accumulated overhead without assuming bounded formula depth. Supply an explicit family of growing-depth functions covered by the theorem.

deliverables.description: GROWING_DEPTH_FAMILY.md: exact parameter growth and uniform constant

acceptance_criteria: Prove termination or summability without assuming a bounded depth or bounded number of composition steps.
Track each overhead term along the full decomposition; a constant per level gives a depth factor unless a proved compensation removes it.
Exhibit a family of growing depth and demonstrate that the new theorem covers it outside a simple restatement of existing read-once/orthogonal closure.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A depth-uniform theorem with a specific growing family or an analytic lower bound on unavoidable accumulated overhead.

assignments.target_statement: Find exact examples showing which constants or hypotheses in new closure results are necessary. Check whether a purported improvement changes only an additive constant that disappears under tensorization.

deliverables.description: CONSTANT_SCOPE.json: necessary coefficients, assumptions, and additive losses

acceptance_criteria: Compute H, I, means, and relevant correlations exactly for each claimed sharpness example.
Distinguish an additive improvement erased by tensorization from a change in the multiplicative universal/class coefficient.
Compare only examples satisfying all of the theorem's fresh-selector, bias, orthogonality, or overlap hypotheses.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A rigorous lower bound on one proposed coefficient or a counterexample identifying a necessary hypothesis.
